_comment: Remote-access posture profile: the SAME FILE ATMProbe reads. EdgeVitals 3.4 and ATMProbe judge RA-001..RA-020 against it.
Its SHA-256 is written into every posture baseline record (profile_hash), so a quiet edit to this file is itself visible.
A missing or rejected file means the built-in default, which is the strict one: RDP deny, no listeners beyond the Windows RPC core.
Check the first baseline from a lab terminal (edgevitals.exe --posture) before rollout, and adjust listener_allow here, not in code.
_note_rdp: deny = RDP enabled is a FAIL. allow_hardened = RDP may be on, but only with NLA, TLS and High encryption (RA-004).
_note_ipc: IPC$ exists whenever the Server service runs. false = WARN while it does; true = PASS. Disk shares (C$, ADMIN$, any other) are always a FAIL.
_note_firewall: true when a vendor firewall replaces Windows Firewall: RA-017 'firewall off' becomes INFO.
_note_powershell: info = report only; restrict = WARN if the execution policy is Unrestricted or Bypass; deny = FAIL if powershell.exe is present.
_note_tools: Remote-control tools the bank authorises (by catalogue name, e.g. "teamviewer"): reported as INFO, not FAIL. remote_tools adds a vendor tool to the catalogue; built-in entries cannot be removed, only allowed.
_note_listeners: Every non-loopback listener not matched here is a RA-020 FAIL. proto tcp|udp; addr exact, "*" (any), "loopback" or "any" (0.0.0.0 / ::); port or port_range [lo, hi]; process and service lower-case, trailing * = prefix. A port range on every address must name a process or service.
